text:
maria: quick design check — small sweep on roles matrix + invite flow + audit-log nav. spotted some accessibility/tab-order stuff that might block the alpha release. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZ/roles-matrix-v3 (see frames: InviteFlow_V3, AuditNav)
kevin: can you list repro steps? I tried the latest on staging and mostly looked OK but will retest.
amy: can we also decide final copy for the SSO toggle? product asked for clear enforcement language.
sam-a11y: repro below. keyboard: tab through top bar -> open org menu -> use open audit log -> try to tab into column filters -> focus traps on the search box and never reaches the date range. happens in Chrome + VoiceOver. probable cause: focusable div with `tabindex="0"` used for sticky header.
maria: exact steps: 1) Login as admin 2) Org settings -> Access -> Audit log 3) Press Tab 6 times until you hit the search box 4) press Tab again -> expected: next filter chip; actual: focus stays in search
kevin: that sticky header component (org-header) has `tabindex=0` for drag handle — that's the likely culprit. I'll try removing tabindex and see.
amy: visual issue: when focus is on chip set the focus ring is 1px dark-blue on 16px background — contrast low when in high-contrast modes. Also the chips' hover vs focus color are same, makes keyboard navigation hard to parse.
sam-a11y: suggested fixes:

- remove unnecessary `tabindex` from non-interactive container
- ensure chips use `outline: 3px solid #0b66ff` or `box-shadow` for focus visible
- aria: make filters region `role="navigation" aria-label="Audit filters"`

Code suggestion for SSO toggle/button copy and aria (for devs):

```
<button id="sso-toggle" role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-label="Require SSO for new members">Require SSO</button>
```

or microcopy variants for PM/design to pick:
- Variant A: "Require SSO for new members" (explicit, a11y-friendly)
- Variant B: "Enforce SSO on invites" (shorter, may be ambiguous)
- Variant C: "Block invites without SSO" (strong, could alarm admins)

maria: lean A for clarity. we need to update help text under toggle: small sentence "New invites will require SSO; existing members unaffected." amy can we mock that in-help microcopy?
amy: yep will add microcopy and a small tooltip: "This applies to future invites only." i'll push updated mock to Figma by EOD.
kevin: for the tab-order fix i pushed a quick branch removing tabindex, and changed the chips to use `button` elements instead of divs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/4287
kevin: note: switching to `button` requires adjusting keyboard handlers — chips were listening to keydown for Enter/Space. preserved behavior and added `aria-pressed` when selection toggles.

sam-a11y: quick aria example for chips:
```
<button class="filter-chip" aria-pressed="false">Embeddings</button>
```

maria: audit-log nav: idea to add keyboard shortcuts (global) to jump to filters: `g then f` like Gmail. Thoughts?
amy: ❤️ for shortcuts but let's add them as optional in settings and show hint tooltip the first time. Also need to ensure they don't conflict with browser or screen reader combos.
kevin: implementation note: use `Mousetrap` or small key handler lib and scope to app shell; we'll gate behind feature flag `auditKeynav`.

dev-bot: deploy-staging: role-access-sweep branch deployed to staging @ 2024-11-08T16:12:22Z :rocket:
maria: OK awesome. next steps: sam to run quick a11y smoke test on staging once PR merged, amy to upload updated microcopy + Figma link, kevin to remove tabindex and ship chips as buttons. I'll consolidate copy decisions in the spec doc and update the release checklist. :thumbsup:
kevin: ping me in thread if you want me to pair on a11y test.
sam-a11y: I can run tests tomorrow morning, will report back with NVDA/VoiceOver notes.
amy: pushed microcopy frame: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZ/roles-matrix-v3?node-id=402:88 — comments added on help text
maria: thanks all. leaving this thread open until staging a11y pass. :eyes:
